def freedman_diaconis_rule(data):
    import numpy as np
    data = data.dropna()  # Rimuove NaN
    data = data[np.isfinite(data)]  # Rimuove inf e -inf
    q25, q75 = np.percentile(data, [1, 99])  # Calcolo IQR
    iqr = q75 - q25
    if iqr == 0:
        return 10
    n = len(data)
    bin_width = 2 * iqr / np.cbrt(n)
